verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable workflow platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or a way to disable them. Self-hosting and encrypted variables are related privacy features, but they are not a documented telemetry opt-out and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
